title: Compromise of a SICAM 8 RTU through the maintenance network

attacker_profile.description: The attacker controls the maintenance laptop or uses compromised credentials.

attack_path.name: Initial Access
attack_path.description: The attacker controls the maintenance laptop or uses compromised credentials.

attack_path.name: Access to the Network Component
attack_path.description: The attacker reaches the RUGGEDCOM RST2428P.

attack_path.name: Manipulation or Bypass of Network Segmentation
attack_path.description: The attacker attempts to modify or bypass network and access controls.

attack_path.name: Compromise of the Control Component
attack_path.description: The attacker attempts to compromise the SICAM 8 CPCI85.

attack_path.name: Impact
attack_path.description: The attacker may impair an operational control or communication function.
